description: Three students with software development backgrounds from SAIT. Our first hackathon altogether.
summary:
Orb-it is an interactive mapping website that allows its users to explore how areas change overtime through influences such as wild fires, floods, earth-quakes, and deforestation by using the SAR satellites. 

We have developed an interactive map with timelines and playback features that visualize the changes in an environment.

Our primary audience are researchers who can examine environmental changes and help them compare changes captured through satellite, and explore the data related to the natural disasters. The secondary audience are students willing to learn environmental changes through natural events with satellite technology.

This project helps the ease of use when it comes to Earth observational data through satellites and visualization making it more accessible and spread awareness about Earths environmental changes.
details: It takes data from the SAR satellite(s) and uses the information given to turn it into data for analyzing wildfires, floods, and earthquakes, wetlands, and vegetation. We used Python to collect and organize data from Earthdata and TypeScript to build the front end and display the data.
